## AWS Terraform variables reference
<https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables>

- [parameter] `name_prefix`: Default=—; Required=yes; Description=Prefix for all resource names. Maximum 15 characters: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter. Format: `{prefix}-{environment}-{resource}`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#core
- [parameter] `environment`: Default=`dev`; Required=no; Description=Environment tag: `dev`, `staging`, `prod`, `test`, or `uat`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#core
- [parameter] `region`: Default=`us-west-2`; Required=no; Description=AWS region for all resources. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#core
- [parameter] `owner`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Team or individual responsible for the deployment. Applied as a tag. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#core
- [parameter] `cost_center`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Cost center or billing label. Applied as a tag when non-empty. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#core
- [parameter] `tags`: Default=`{}`; Required=no; Description=Additional tags applied to all resources. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#core
- [parameter] `create_vpc`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Create a new VPC. Set `false` to use an existing one. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#networking
- [parameter] `vpc_id`: Default=`null`; Required=when `!create_vpc`; Description=Existing VPC ID. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#networking
- [parameter] `private_subnets`: Default=`[]`; Required=when `!create_vpc`; Description=Existing private subnet IDs. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#networking
- [parameter] `public_subnets`: Default=`[]`; Required=when `!create_vpc`; Description=Existing public subnet IDs. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#networking
- [parameter] `vpc_cidr_block`: Default=`null`; Required=when `!create_vpc`; Description=Existing VPC CIDR block. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#networking
- [parameter] `vpc_private_subnets`: Default=`[]`; Required=no; Description=Override CIDRs for private subnets when `create_vpc = true`. Empty uses the module default. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#networking
- [parameter] `vpc_public_subnets`: Default=`[]`; Required=no; Description=Override CIDRs for public subnets when `create_vpc = true`. Empty uses the module default. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#networking
- [parameter] `enable_public_eks_cluster`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable the public EKS API endpoint. Set `false` for a private cluster and enable `create_bastion` to run Terraform and Helm from the bastion via SSM. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#eks
- [parameter] `eks_public_access_cidrs`: Default=`["0.0.0.0/0"]`; Required=no; Description=CIDRs allowed to reach the public EKS API endpoint. Restrict to corporate VPN egress CIDRs to lock down access. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#eks
- [parameter] `eks_cluster_version`: Default=`1.33`; Required=no; Description=EKS Kubernetes version. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#eks
- [parameter] `eks_managed_node_group_defaults`: Default=`{ami_type = "AL2023_x86_64_STANDARD"}`; Required=no; Description=Default configuration applied to all managed node groups. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#eks
- [parameter] `eks_managed_node_groups`: Default=one `default` group: `m5.4xlarge`, min 3 / max 10; Required=no; Description=Managed node group definitions. `desired_size` defaults to `min_size` when omitted. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#eks
- [parameter] `create_gp3_storage_class`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Create `gp3` and set it as the default `StorageClass` with volume expansion enabled. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#eks
- [parameter] `eks_cluster_enabled_log_types`: Default=`["api", "audit", "authenticator", "controllerManager", "scheduler"]`; Required=no; Description=EKS control plane log types sent to CloudWatch. Set `[]` to disable. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#eks
- [parameter] `eks_addons`: Default=`{}`; Required=no; Description=EKS managed add-on configurations (`coredns`, `kube-proxy`, `vpc-cni`, and similar). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#eks
- [parameter] `create_langsmith_irsa_role`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Create the IRSA role for LangSmith pods (S3 access). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#eks
- [parameter] `postgres_source`: Default=`external`; Required=no; Description=`external` (RDS with private access) or `in-cluster` (deployed via Helm). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_instance_type`: Default=`db.t3.large`; Required=no; Description=RDS instance class. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_storage_gb`: Default=`10`; Required=no; Description=Initial RDS storage in GB. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_max_storage_gb`: Default=`100`; Required=no; Description=Maximum RDS storage in GB (autoscaling). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_username`: Default=`langsmith`; Required=no; Description=RDS database username. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_engine_version`: Default=`16`; Required=no; Description=PostgreSQL engine version. PG 14 reaches EOL in November 2026; 16 is recommended for new deployments. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_password`: Default=`""`; Required=when external; Description=RDS password. Set via `TF_VAR_postgres_password`, or auto-generated and stored in SSM by `setup-env.sh`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_iam_database_authentication_enabled`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable IAM database authentication on RDS. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_iam_database_user`: Default=`null`; Required=no; Description=Database user for IAM authentication. Must exist in PostgreSQL with `GRANT rds_iam TO <user>`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_deletion_protection`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Prevent accidental RDS deletion. Set `false` for dev/test environments. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `postgres_backup_retention_period`: Default=`7`; Required=no; Description=Days to retain automated RDS backups. `0` disables backups. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#postgresql-rds
- [parameter] `redis_source`: Default=`external`; Required=no; Description=`external` (ElastiCache with private access) or `in-cluster` (deployed via Helm). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#redis-elasticache
- [parameter] `redis_instance_type`: Default=`cache.m6g.xlarge`; Required=no; Description=ElastiCache node type. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#redis-elasticache
- [parameter] `redis_auth_token`: Default=`""`; Required=when external; Description=ElastiCache auth token. Auto-generated by `setup-env.sh` and stored in SSM. Set via `TF_VAR_redis_auth_token`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#redis-elasticache
- [parameter] `s3_ttl_enabled`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable S3 lifecycle rules to expire trace blobs. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#s3
- [parameter] `s3_ttl_short_days`: Default=`14`; Required=no; Description=Days before expiring short-lived objects (`ttl_s/` prefix). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#s3
- [parameter] `s3_ttl_long_days`: Default=`400`; Required=no; Description=Days before expiring long-lived objects (`ttl_l/` prefix). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#s3
- [parameter] `s3_kms_key_arn`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=KMS CMK ARN for S3 encryption. Empty uses SSE-S3 (AES256). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#s3
- [parameter] `s3_versioning_enabled`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable S3 bucket versioning. Increases storage cost as prior versions are retained. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#s3
- [parameter] `tls_certificate_source`: Default=`acm`; Required=no; Description=TLS source: `acm`, `letsencrypt` (cert-manager HTTP-01 ACME solved through the ALB), or `none`. For DNS-01 challenges through Route 53 (in-cluster gateways), use `create_cert_manager_irsa` instead; the two are mutually exclusive. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#tls-and-dns
- [parameter] `acm_certificate_arn`: Default=`""`; Required=when `acm`; Description=Existing ACM certificate ARN. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#tls-and-dns
- [parameter] `letsencrypt_email`: Default=`""`; Required=when `letsencrypt`; Description=Email for Let's Encrypt ACME registration. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#tls-and-dns
- [parameter] `langsmith_domain`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Custom domain. When set (and `acm_certificate_arn` is empty), provisions a Route 53 hosted zone, ACM certificate, and alias record. Empty uses the ALB hostname. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#tls-and-dns
- [parameter] `dns_include_wildcard_san`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Add a wildcard SAN (`*.<langsmith_domain>`) to the ACM certificate. Needed for HTTPS on subdomains. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#tls-and-dns
- [parameter] `langsmith_namespace`: Default=`langsmith`; Required=no; Description=Kubernetes namespace for LangSmith. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#tls-and-dns
- [parameter] `alb_scheme`: Default=`internet-facing`; Required=no; Description=ALB scheme: `internet-facing` (public subnets) or `internal` (private subnets, reachable via VPN, peering, or PrivateLink). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `alb_allowed_cidr_blocks`: Default=`["0.0.0.0/0"]`; Required=no; Description=CIDRs allowed to reach the ALB on HTTP/HTTPS. Restrict to VPN or office CIDRs for limited-access deployments. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `alb_access_logs_enabled`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable ALB access logging to a dedicated S3 bucket. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `enable_envoy_gateway`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Install Envoy Gateway (Kubernetes Gateway API) instead of ALB Ingress. Required for multi-namespace dataplane deployments. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `enable_nginx_ingress`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Install the NGINX ingress controller. The ALB forwards to NGINX controller pods via a `TargetGroupBinding`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `enable_istio_gateway`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Open port 15017 on the node security group for the istiod sidecar-injector webhook. Required when running Istio on EKS. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `istio_nlb_scheme`: Default=`internet-facing`; Required=no; Description=Scheme for the Istio ingress gateway NLB: `internet-facing` or `internal`. Written to `tfvars` by the setup wizard but not yet consumed by any module; the Istio path currently uses a ClusterIP service behind the ALB `TargetGroupBinding`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `create_cert_manager_irsa`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Create the IRSA role for cert-manager DNS-01 challenges via Route 53. Required for Let's Encrypt with Istio Gateway. Run `make tls` after apply. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `cert_manager_hosted_zone_id`: Default=`""`; Required=when `create_cert_manager_irsa`; Description=Route 53 hosted zone ID for cert-manager DNS-01 TXT records. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `clickhouse_source`: Default=`in-cluster`; Required=no; Description=`in-cluster` (dev/POC only) or `external` (LangChain Managed ClickHouse, recommended for production). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `create_bastion`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Create an EC2 bastion in a public subnet for private cluster access via SSM Session Manager or SSH. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#bastion-private-cluster
- [parameter] `bastion_instance_type`: Default=`t3.micro`; Required=no; Description=EC2 instance type for the bastion. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#bastion-private-cluster
- [parameter] `bastion_key_name`: Default=`null`; Required=no; Description=EC2 key pair for SSH. Empty uses SSM Session Manager only. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#bastion-private-cluster
- [parameter] `bastion_enable_ssh`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Open port 22 on the bastion security group. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#bastion-private-cluster
- [parameter] `bastion_ssh_allowed_cidrs`: Default=`[]`; Required=no; Description=CIDRs allowed to SSH to the bastion. Used only when `bastion_enable_ssh = true`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#bastion-private-cluster
- [parameter] `bastion_root_volume_size_gb`: Default=`20`; Required=no; Description=Root EBS volume size in GB for the bastion. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#bastion-private-cluster
- [parameter] `create_cloudtrail`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Create a CloudTrail trail logging AWS API calls to S3. Skip if an account-level or org-level trail already exists. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#security-and-audit
- [parameter] `cloudtrail_multi_region`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Record API calls across all regions. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#security-and-audit
- [parameter] `cloudtrail_log_retention_days`: Default=`365`; Required=no; Description=Days to retain CloudTrail logs in S3. `0` keeps them indefinitely. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#security-and-audit
- [parameter] `create_waf`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Attach a WAFv2 Web ACL to the ALB (AWS managed rules for OWASP Top 10, IP reputation, bad inputs). Cost: about `$8` to `$10`/mo base. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#security-and-audit
- [parameter] `create_firewall`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Deploy AWS Network Firewall for FQDN-based egress filtering. Requires `create_vpc = true`. Cost: about `$0.395/hr` per endpoint plus `$0.065/GB`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#security-and-audit
- [parameter] `firewall_allowed_fqdns`: Default=`["beacon.langchain.com"]`; Required=no; Description=Domains allowed for outbound traffic when `create_firewall = true`. Matched against TLS SNI and HTTP Host headers. All other destinations are dropped. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#security-and-audit
- [parameter] `firewall_subnet_cidr`: Default=`10.0.64.0/21`; Required=no; Description=CIDR for the firewall subnet. Must be within the VPC CIDR and must not overlap private or public subnets. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#security-and-audit
- [parameter] `sizing_profile`: Default=`default`; Required=no; Description=Helm sizing: `production`, `production-large`, `dev`, `minimum`, or `default`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `enable_deployments`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable LangSmith Deployment (listener, operator, host-backend). Requires the Deployments license entitlement. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `enable_agent_builder`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable Agent Builder. Requires `enable_deployments = true` and the Agent Builder entitlement. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `enable_insights`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable Insights (ClickHouse-backed analytics). Requires the Insights entitlement. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `enable_polly`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable Polly (AI evaluation and monitoring). Requires `enable_deployments = true` and the Polly entitlement. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `enable_usage_telemetry`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable extended usage telemetry reporting. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `enable_fleet`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable Fleet standalone deployment (chart v0.15+). Requires `enable_deployments = true` and external Postgres and Redis. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `enable_standalone_polly`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable Polly standalone deployment (chart v0.15+). Does not require `enable_deployments`. Requires external Postgres and Redis. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `enable_standalone_insights`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable Insights standalone deployment (chart v0.15+). Does not require `enable_deployments`. Requires external Postgres and Redis. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `langsmith_license_key`: LangSmith enterprise license key. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_admin_password`: Initial org admin password. Minimum 12 characters, with lowercase, uppercase, and a symbol. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_api_key_salt`: Salt for hashing API keys. Must stay stable after first deploy. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_jwt_secret`: JWT secret for Basic Auth sessions. Must stay stable. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_deployments_encryption_key`: Fernet key for LangSmith Deployments. Must never change. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_agent_builder_encryption_key`: Fernet key for Agent Builder. Must never change. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_insights_encryption_key`: Fernet key for Insights. Must never change. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_polly_encryption_key`: Fernet key for Polly. Must never change. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [definition] AWS Terraform variables reference — Complete reference for every input variable exposed by the [AWS Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/aws). Use it while filling in `terraform.tfvars` for the first time or tuning an existing deployment. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#aws-terraform-variables-reference
- [definition] Sizing and feature flags — `sizing_profile` and most `enable_*` flags are read by `init-values.sh` and `deploy.sh`; Terraform does not act on them directly. They affect which Helm overlay files the scripts generate. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [definition] Sensitive values (set with `setup-env.sh`) — Sourcing `infra/scripts/setup-env.sh` writes these to AWS SSM Parameter Store. External Secrets Operator syncs them into the cluster as Kubernetes secrets. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh

Managing the deployment as code lets you version, review, and reproduce your LangSmith environment across subscriptions instead of clicking through the Azure Portal. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#deploy-langsmith-on-azure-with-terraform
- [definition] Required Azure RBAC — The identity running Terraform needs the following roles on the subscription: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#required-azure-rbac
- [definition] Quickstart — For a condensed cheat sheet of `make` targets, required variables, and common constraints, see the [Azure quick reference](/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#quickstart
- [definition] Provision infrastructure — Terraform provisions the following Azure resources: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [definition] Apply — Provisioning the Azure cloud foundation takes 15 to 20 minutes on a clean subscription. Do not interrupt the apply. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#apply
- [definition] Cluster credentials and Kubernetes Secrets — After `make apply` completes, get cluster credentials and push secrets into the cluster: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#cluster-credentials-and-kubernetes-secrets
- [definition] Deploy LangSmith — Use one of the two supported deployment paths: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#deploy-langsmith
- [definition] Terraform path — Use this path when you want the Helm release, Kubernetes Secrets, and Workload Identity ServiceAccount managed in Terraform state. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#terraform-path
- [definition] Values chain — `make deploy` applies Helm values files in this order (last file wins on conflicts): — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#values-chain
- [definition] Enable add-ons — Each add-on is gated by a flag in `infra/terraform.tfvars`. Set the flag, re-run `make init-values` to regenerate values, then re-run `make deploy`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#enable-add-ons
- [definition] LangSmith Deployment — Enables [LangSmith Deployment](/langsmith/deploy-self-hosted-full-platform), which lets you deploy and manage agents as API servers directly from the [LangSmith… — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#langsmith-deployment
- [definition] Agent Builder — Provides visual AI-assisted creation and management of LangGraph agents from the LangSmith UI. No `terraform apply` needed; run `make init-values && make deploy`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#agent-builder
- [definition] Insights and Polly — Two features, both of which require LangSmith Deployment. They are independent of each other; enable either one without the other. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#insights-and-polly
- [definition] Ingress controllers — Set `ingress_controller` in `terraform.tfvars` before `make apply`. For the full TLS compatibility matrix, see `INGRESS_CONTROLLERS.md` in the [Azure module repo](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/blob/main/modules/azure/INGRESS_CONTROLLERS.md). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#ingress-controllers
- [definition] DNS and TLS — `dns_label` gives you a free Azure subdomain, `<label>.<region>.cloudapp.azure.com`, with no domain registration or DNS zone needed. `deploy.sh` annotates the correct LoadBalancer service automatically. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy#dns-and-tls

- [parameter] Infrastructure: What gets deployed=AKS + Postgres + Redis + Blob + Key Vault + cert-manager + KEDA + ingress; Command=`make apply` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#deployment-overview
- [parameter] Cluster credentials: What gets deployed=Kubeconfig + Kubernetes Secrets from Key Vault; Command=`make kubeconfig && make k8s-secrets` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#deployment-overview
- [parameter] LangSmith (Helm path): What gets deployed=LangSmith Helm (~17 pods) via shell scripts; Command=`make init-values && make deploy` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#deployment-overview
- [parameter] LangSmith (Terraform path): What gets deployed=Secrets + SA + Helm release managed in Terraform state; Command=`make init-app && make apply-app` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#deployment-overview
- [parameter] LangSmith Deployment add-on: What gets deployed=host-backend, listener, operator. Bump `default_node_pool_min_count` to 5 first; Command=`make apply && make init-values && make deploy` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#deployment-overview
- [parameter] Agent Builder add-on: What gets deployed=tool-server, trigger-server, agent-builder LGP; Command=`make init-values && make deploy` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#deployment-overview
- [parameter] Insights + Polly add-on: What gets deployed=Clio analytics, Polly eval agent; Command=`make init-values && make deploy` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#deployment-overview
- [parameter] `minimum`: Cost parking, CI smoke tests, single-user demos. Expect OOM under real traffic. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#sizing-profiles
- [parameter] `dev`: Light non-production for local dev, CI pipelines, integration tests, short-lived POCs. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#sizing-profiles
- [parameter] `production`: _Recommended_ for production. Multi-replica with HPA on all stateless components. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#sizing-profiles
- [parameter] `production-large`: High-volume starting point based on the scale guide (~50 concurrent users, ~1000 traces/sec). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#sizing-profiles

All `make` targets run from `modules/azure/`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#azure-terraform-quick-reference
- [definition] Add-ons — Add-on stages (3 to 5) are controlled by flags in `infra/terraform.tfvars`. Set the flags, re-run `init-values && deploy`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#add-ons
- [definition] Sizing profiles — Set `sizing_profile` in `terraform.tfvars`, then re-run `make init-values && make deploy`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference#sizing-profiles

## Azure Terraform variables reference
<https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables>

- [parameter] `subscription_id`: Default=—; Required=yes; Description=Azure subscription ID for the deployment. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#core
- [parameter] `location`: Default=`eastus`; Required=no; Description=Azure region for the deployment. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#core
- [parameter] `identifier`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Suffix appended to every resource name to distinguish environments (for example, `-prod`, `-staging`). Must start with a hyphen or be empty. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#core
- [parameter] `environment`: Default=`dev`; Required=no; Description=Environment tag applied to all resources. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#core
- [parameter] `owner`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Email or team name of the resource owner. Applied as a tag. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#core
- [parameter] `cost_center`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Cost center or billing code. Applied as a tag. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#core
- [parameter] `create_vnet`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Create a new VNet. Set `false` to bring your own VNet and subnets. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#networking
- [parameter] `vnet_id`: Default=`""`; Required=when `!create_vnet`; Description=Existing VNet resource ID. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#networking
- [parameter] `aks_subnet_id`: Default=`""`; Required=when `!create_vnet`; Description=Existing subnet ID for the AKS cluster. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#networking
- [parameter] `postgres_subnet_id`: Default=`""`; Required=when `!create_vnet`; Description=Existing subnet ID for the PostgreSQL server. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#networking
- [parameter] `redis_subnet_id`: Default=`""`; Required=when `!create_vnet`; Description=Existing subnet ID for the Redis instance. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#networking
- [parameter] `postgres_subnet_address_prefix`: Default=`["10.0.32.0/20"]`; Required=no; Description=CIDR prefix for the PostgreSQL subnet. Can be disjoint ranges. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#networking
- [parameter] `redis_subnet_address_prefix`: Default=`["10.0.48.0/20"]`; Required=no; Description=CIDR prefix for the Redis subnet. Can be disjoint ranges. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#networking
- [parameter] `aks_authorized_ip_ranges`: Default=`[]`; Required=no; Description=External CIDRs permitted to reach the AKS API server. Empty leaves the API server publicly reachable so Terraform-driven Helm and `kubectl` steps work from any apply host. Populate with operator and CI egress CIDRs for production. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#networking
- [parameter] `default_node_pool_vm_size`: Default=`Standard_D8s_v3`; Required=no; Description=VM size for the default node pool. `Standard_D8s_v3` (8 vCPU / 32 GiB) is the recommended baseline for the core platform with external Postgres and Redis. Use `Standard_D4s_v3` (4 vCPU / 16 GiB) only for light or demo deployments with in-cluster databases. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#aks
- [parameter] `default_node_pool_min_count`: Default=`1`; Required=no; Description=Minimum node count for the default pool. The autoscaler never scales below this floor. Set to 3 for production (the core platform needs about 14.4 vCPU, which three `Standard_D8s_v3` nodes cover). Set to 1 for minimum or dev deployments. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#aks
- [parameter] `default_node_pool_max_count`: Default=`10`; Required=no; Description=Maximum node count for the default pool. Core platform uses 4 to 6 nodes; add headroom as you enable add-ons (LangSmith Deployment ~6, Agent Builder ~8, Insights 10 to 12). Raising this takes effect immediately with no node restarts. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#aks
- [parameter] `default_node_pool_max_pods`: Default=`60`; Required=no; Description=Maximum pods per node in the default pool. The Azure CNI default of 30 is too low for LangSmith; 60 fits a full deployment on a single node. Immutable: changing it recreates the node pool. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#aks
- [parameter] `additional_node_pools`: Default=`large: Standard_D16s_v3, 0–2`; Required=no; Description=Additional node pools. The default `large` pool (`Standard_D16s_v3`, 16 vCPU / 64 GiB) is required for ClickHouse (requests 3.5 vCPU / 15 GiB) and LangSmith Deployment agent pods. `min_count = 0` scales it to zero when idle. Raise `max_count` to 3 or more for Agent Builder with multiple simultaneous… — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#aks
- [parameter] `aks_service_cidr`: Default=`10.0.64.0/20`; Required=no; Description=Kubernetes service CIDR. Must not overlap the VNet. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#aks
- [parameter] `aks_dns_service_ip`: Default=`10.0.64.10`; Required=no; Description=CoreDNS service IP. Must be within `aks_service_cidr`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#aks
- [parameter] `aks_deletion_protection`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Prevent accidental AKS cluster deletion. Set `false` for dev/test. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#aks
- [parameter] `availability_zones`: Default=`["1"]`; Required=no; Description=Availability zones to deploy into. Use `["1", "2", "3"]` for zone-redundant HA. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#aks
- [parameter] `postgres_source`: Default=`external`; Required=no; Description=`external` provisions Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server (private VNet). `in-cluster` uses the chart-managed Postgres pod (dev/demo only). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#data-sources
- [parameter] `redis_source`: Default=`external`; Required=no; Description=`external` provisions Azure Managed Redis (private VNet). `in-cluster` uses the chart-managed Redis pod (dev/demo only). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#data-sources
- [parameter] `clickhouse_source`: Default=`in-cluster`; Required=no; Description=`in-cluster` (dev/POC only) or `external` for [LangChain Managed ClickHouse](/langsmith/langsmith-managed-clickhouse), recommended for production. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#data-sources
- [parameter] `postgres_admin_username`: Default=`langsmith`; Required=no; Description=PostgreSQL administrator username. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#postgresql
- [parameter] `postgres_admin_password`: Default=`""`; Required=when external; Description=PostgreSQL administrator password. Set via `make setup-env`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#postgresql
- [parameter] `postgres_database_name`: Default=`langsmith`; Required=no; Description=Name of the database LangSmith connects to. Must match the database that exists on the server. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#postgresql
- [parameter] `postgres_deletion_protection`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Prevent accidental PostgreSQL server deletion. Set `false` for dev/test. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#postgresql
- [parameter] `postgres_geo_redundant_backup`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable geo-redundant backups for PostgreSQL. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#postgresql
- [parameter] `postgres_standby_availability_zone`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Standby AZ for PostgreSQL zone-redundant HA. Empty disables the HA standby. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#postgresql
- [parameter] `amr_sku`: Default=`Balanced_B0`; Required=no; Description=Azure Managed Redis SKU. `Balanced_B0` is the smallest. Move up (`Balanced_B1`, `Balanced_B3`, and so on) if the region reports `AllocationFailed`. Replaces the classic `redis_capacity`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#redis
- [parameter] `blob_ttl_enabled`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable lifecycle TTL rules on the blob container. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#blob-storage
- [parameter] `blob_ttl_short_days`: Default=`14`; Required=no; Description=TTL in days for short-lived trace blobs. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#blob-storage
- [parameter] `blob_ttl_long_days`: Default=`400`; Required=no; Description=TTL in days for long-lived trace blobs. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#blob-storage
- [parameter] `storage_allowed_ips`: Default=`[]`; Required=no; Description=Public IPs or CIDRs allowed through the storage account default-deny firewall. AKS pod traffic is allowlisted automatically via the `Microsoft.Storage` service endpoint. Add only external clients (operator workstations, CI runners) that need the blob data plane. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#blob-storage
- [parameter] `keyvault_name`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Key Vault name. Must be globally unique, 3 to 24 characters. When empty, `main.tf` computes `langsmith-kv<identifier>`. Override to avoid naming conflicts. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#key-vault
- [parameter] `keyvault_purge_protection`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable purge protection. Set `false` for dev/test to allow immediate name reuse after destroy. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#key-vault
- [parameter] `keyvault_default_action`: Default=`Allow`; Required=no; Description=Default action for the Key Vault data-plane firewall. `Allow` keeps the first apply (which creates secrets via the data plane) working. Production sets `Deny` and populates `keyvault_allowed_ips`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#key-vault
- [parameter] `keyvault_allowed_ips`: Default=`[]`; Required=no; Description=Public IPs or CIDRs allowed through the Key Vault firewall when `keyvault_default_action = "Deny"`. - [parameter] `ingress_controller`: Default=`nginx`; Required=no; Description=Ingress controller: `nginx`, `istio` (self-managed Helm), `istio-addon` (Azure managed Istio, recommended on Azure), `agic` (Application Gateway Ingress Controller), `envoy-gateway` (Gateway API), or `none`. - [parameter] `agic_subnet_address_prefix`: Default=`["10.0.96.0/24"]`; Required=no; Description=CIDR for the Application Gateway dedicated subnet. Must be `/24` or larger. - [parameter] `envoy_gateway_version`: Default=`v1.2.0`; Required=no; Description=Envoy Gateway Helm chart version. Used only when `ingress_controller = "envoy-gateway"`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `ingress_ip`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Public IP of the ingress load balancer, used by the DNS module for the A record. Get it with `kubectl get svc -n ingress-nginx`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#ingress
- [parameter] `dns_label`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Azure Public IP DNS label for the ingress load balancer. Results in `<label>.<region>.cloudapp.azure.com`. Its variables live in `app/terraform.tfvars`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables#app-module-variables-terraform-path

- [parameter] Helm: Version=3.12; Purpose=Install and manage the LangSmith chart — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-tools
- [parameter] `roles/container.admin`: Create and manage GKE clusters — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-iam-roles
- [parameter] `roles/compute.networkAdmin`: Create VPC, subnets, firewall rules — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-iam-roles
- [parameter] `roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin`: Create service accounts for Workload Identity — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-iam-roles
- [parameter] `roles/cloudsql.admin`: Create and manage Cloud SQL instances — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-iam-roles
- [parameter] `roles/redis.admin`: Create and manage Memorystore Redis — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-iam-roles
- [parameter] `roles/storage.admin`: Create GCS buckets and lifecycle policies — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-iam-roles
- [parameter] `roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin`: Grant IAM bindings during provisioning — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-iam-roles
- [parameter] `roles/servicenetworking.networksAdmin`: Create private service connections (required for Cloud SQL and Redis) — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-iam-roles
- [parameter] VPC + subnet + Cloud NAT: Private network for the cluster and managed services — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [parameter] Private service connection: VPC peering for Cloud SQL and Memorystore private IPs — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [parameter] GKE cluster (Standard or Autopilot): Kubernetes compute, Workload Identity enabled — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [parameter] Cloud SQL PostgreSQL: LangSmith operational data, HA standby, private IP — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [parameter] Memorystore Redis: Queue and cache, STANDARD_HA tier, private IP — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [parameter] GCS bucket: Trace payload blob storage, lifecycle rules — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [parameter] Workload Identity service account: Per-pod GCP access without static keys — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [parameter] cert-manager, KEDA, Envoy Gateway: Bootstrap workloads installed alongside infrastructure — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [parameter] [Script-driven Helm deploy _(recommended)_](#script-driven-helm-deploy-recommended): Command=`make init-values && make deploy`; When to use=Interactive output, kubeconfig refresh, preflight checks. Best for first-time deploys and day-2 re-deploys. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#deploy-langsmith
- [parameter] [Terraform-managed Helm release](#terraform-managed-helm-release): Command=`make init-app && make apply-app`; When to use=Helm release managed in Terraform state alongside infrastructure. Best for GitOps and CI/CD pipelines. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#deploy-langsmith
- [parameter] [Manual Helm install](#manual-helm-install): Command=`helm upgrade --install langsmith langchain/langsmith ...`; When to use=Direct `helm` usage without the wrapper scripts. Best for teams with existing Helm tooling. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#deploy-langsmith
- [parameter] `default`: Chart defaults, no overlay applied — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#sizing-profiles
- [parameter] `minimum`: Absolute floor, fits `e2-standard-4`. Cost parking or CI smoke tests — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#sizing-profiles
- [parameter] `dev`: Single replica, minimal resources — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#sizing-profiles
- [parameter] `production`: Multi-replica with HPA. Recommended for real workloads — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#sizing-profiles
- [parameter] `production-large`: High memory, high CPU. 50+ users or 1000+ traces/sec — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#sizing-profiles
- [definition] Deploy LangSmith on GCP with Terraform — Deploy LangSmith to GCP with the public [Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/gcp). Managing the deployment as code lets you version, review, and reproduce your LangSmith environment across projects instead of clicking through the Google Cloud console. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#deploy-langsmith-on-gcp-with-terraform
- [definition] Required GCP APIs — Terraform enables these automatically on first apply, but `cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com` must be enabled first so Terraform can enable the rest. Enable everything manually for fast first runs: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-gcp-apis
- [definition] Required IAM roles — The principal running Terraform needs the following roles on the target project. Trim to least-privilege after the initial deployment is stable. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#required-iam-roles
- [definition] Quickstart — For a condensed cheat sheet of `make` targets, required variables, and common constraints, see the [GCP quick reference](/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-quick-reference). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#quickstart
- [definition] Provision infrastructure — Terraform provisions the following GCP resources: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#provision-infrastructure
- [definition] Apply — Provisioning the GCP cloud foundation takes 25 to 35 minutes on a clean project. Do not interrupt the apply. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#apply
- [definition] Deploy LangSmith — Use one of the three supported deployment paths: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#deploy-langsmith
- [definition] Script-driven Helm deploy (recommended) — Two commands install the LangSmith chart with sensible defaults wired from Terraform outputs: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#script-driven-helm-deploy-recommended
- [definition] Terraform-managed Helm release — Keep the entire deployment under Terraform. The `app` layer wraps the same chart and layered values files as the deploy script, managed as a `helm_release` resource. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#terraform-managed-helm-release
- [definition] Manual Helm install — Best for teams running `helm` directly without the scripts. Generate the required secrets first: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#manual-helm-install
- [definition] Sizing profiles — Set `sizing_profile` in `terraform.tfvars`, then re-run `make init-values && make deploy`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#sizing-profiles
- [definition] Enable add-ons — Each add-on is gated by a flag in `infra/terraform.tfvars`. Set the flag, re-apply Terraform, then re-run `make init-values && make deploy`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#enable-add-ons
- [definition] LangSmith Deployment — Adds `host-backend`, `listener`, and `operator`. Required before enabling Agent Builder or Insights. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#langsmith-deployment
- [definition] Fleet — Fleet is the current form of the feature formerly called Agent Builder, deployed as a standalone service (chart v0.15+). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#fleet
- [definition] Agent Builder (deprecated) — On GCP, `enable_agent_builder` is deprecated in favor of [Fleet](#fleet) (`enable_fleet`, chart v0.15+). Use Fleet for new deployments. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#agent-builder-deprecated
- [definition] Insights and Polly — Prerequisite: Agent Builder healthy. Insights enables ClickHouse-backed trace analytics. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy#insights-and-polly

## GCP Terraform troubleshooting
<https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting>

- [snippet] Automated diagnostics: make status — `# Full deployment health check + next-step guidance` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#automated-diagnostics
- [snippet] terraform apply fails: GCP APIs not enabled: Error 403: ... has not been used in project <project-id> before or it is disabled. — `Error 403: ... has not been used in project <project-id> before or it is disabled.` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#terraform-apply-fails-gcp-apis-not-enabled
- [snippet] terraform apply fails: GCP APIs not enabled: gcloud services enable cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com --project <project-id> — `gcloud services enable cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com --project <project-id>` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#terraform-apply-fails-gcp-apis-not-enabled
- [snippet] GKE cluster API server not accessible after apply: Error: Get "https://<cluster-endpoint>/api/v1/namespaces": dial tcp: connection refused — `Error: Get "https://<cluster-endpoint>/api/v1/namespaces": dial tcp: connection refused` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#gke-cluster-api-server-not-accessible-after-apply
- [snippet] GKE cluster API server not accessible after apply: gcloud container clusters describe <cluster-name> \ — `gcloud container clusters describe <cluster-name> \` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#gke-cluster-api-server-not-accessible-after-apply
- [snippet] GKE nodes not joining (NotReady): gcloud container node-pools describe <pool-name> \ — `gcloud container node-pools describe <pool-name> \` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#gke-nodes-not-joining-notready
- [snippet] Cloud SQL connection refused from GKE pods: gcloud services vpc-peerings list --network <vpc-name> --project <project-id> — `gcloud services vpc-peerings list --network <vpc-name> --project <project-id>` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#cloud-sql-connection-refused-from-gke-pods
- [snippet] Cloud SQL connection refused from GKE pods: terraform apply -var-file=terraform.tfvars -target=module.networking — `terraform apply -var-file=terraform.tfvars -target=module.networking` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#cloud-sql-connection-refused-from-gke-pods
- [snippet] Memorystore Redis connection timeout: gcloud redis instances describe <instance-name> --region <region> \ — `gcloud redis instances describe <instance-name> --region <region> \` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#memorystore-redis-connection-timeout
- [snippet] cert-manager fails to issue Let's Encrypt certificate: kubectl get svc -n envoy-gateway-system \ — `kubectl get svc -n envoy-gateway-system \` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#cert-manager-fails-to-issue-lets-encrypt-certificate
- [snippet] GCS bucket access denied from LangSmith pods: helm get values langsmith -n langsmith | grep bucketName — `# Confirm the bucket and its IAM bindings` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting#gcs-bucket-access-denied-from-langsmith-pods

## GCP Terraform variables reference
<https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables>

- [parameter] `project_id`: Default=—; Required=yes; Description=GCP project ID where resources are created. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#core
- [parameter] `region`: Default=`us-west2`; Required=no; Description=GCP region for regional resources. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#core
- [parameter] `zone`: Default=`us-west2-a`; Required=no; Description=GCP zone for zonal resources. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#core
- [parameter] `environment`: Default=`prod`; Required=no; Description=Environment name applied to labels: `dev`, `staging`, or `prod`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#core
- [parameter] `name_prefix`: Default=`ls`; Required=no; Description=Prefix for all resource names. 1 to 11 characters, starting with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#core
- [parameter] `unique_suffix`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Append a random suffix to resource names. Recommended for multi-tenant projects. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#core
- [parameter] `owner`: Default=`platform-team`; Required=no; Description=Owner label applied to all resources. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#core
- [parameter] `cost_center`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=Cost center label for billing attribution. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#core
- [parameter] `labels`: Default=`{}`; Required=no; Description=Additional labels applied to all resources. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#core
- [parameter] `subnet_cidr`: Default=`10.0.0.0/20`; Required=no; Description=CIDR for the GKE subnet. Must not overlap existing ranges. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#networking
- [parameter] `pods_cidr`: Default=`10.4.0.0/14`; Required=no; Description=CIDR for GKE pods. Must not overlap the subnet or services range. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#networking
- [parameter] `services_cidr`: Default=`10.8.0.0/20`; Required=no; Description=CIDR for GKE services. Must not overlap the subnet or pods range. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#networking
- [parameter] `gke_master_authorized_cidrs`: Default=`[]`; Required=no; Description=External CIDRs permitted to reach the GKE control plane endpoint. Empty leaves the control plane publicly reachable so Terraform-managed Helm and `kubectl` steps work from any apply host. Populate with operator and CI egress CIDRs for production. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#networking
- [parameter] `gke_use_autopilot`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Use GKE Autopilot mode. Autopilot always uses Dataplane V2. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gke
- [parameter] `gke_node_count`: Default=`2`; Required=no; Description=Initial node count per zone (Standard mode only). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gke
- [parameter] `gke_min_nodes`: Default=`2`; Required=no; Description=Minimum nodes per zone for autoscaling. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gke
- [parameter] `gke_max_nodes`: Default=`10`; Required=no; Description=Maximum nodes per zone for autoscaling. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gke
- [parameter] `gke_machine_type`: Default=`e2-standard-4`; Required=no; Description=GKE node machine type (for example `e2-standard-4`, `n2-standard-8`). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gke
- [parameter] `gke_disk_size`: Default=`100`; Required=no; Description=Node disk size in GB. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gke
- [parameter] `gke_release_channel`: Default=`REGULAR`; Required=no; Description=GKE release channel: `RAPID`, `REGULAR`, or `STABLE`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gke
- [parameter] `gke_deletion_protection`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable deletion protection on the GKE cluster. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gke
- [parameter] `gke_network_policy_provider`: Default=`DATA_PLANE_V2`; Required=no; Description=Network policy provider: `CALICO` (legacy) or `DATA_PLANE_V2` (Cilium-based, recommended). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gke
- [parameter] `postgres_source`: Default=`external`; Required=no; Description=`external` (Cloud SQL with private IP) or `in-cluster` (deployed via Helm). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#postgresql-cloud-sql
- [parameter] `postgres_version`: Default=`POSTGRES_15`; Required=no; Description=Cloud SQL PostgreSQL version. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#postgresql-cloud-sql
- [parameter] `postgres_tier`: Default=`db-custom-2-8192`; Required=no; Description=Cloud SQL machine tier (for example `db-f1-micro`, `db-custom-2-8192`). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#postgresql-cloud-sql
- [parameter] `postgres_disk_size`: Default=`50`; Required=no; Description=Cloud SQL disk size in GB. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#postgresql-cloud-sql
- [parameter] `postgres_high_availability`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable Cloud SQL HA (regional standby). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#postgresql-cloud-sql
- [parameter] `postgres_deletion_protection`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable deletion protection on Cloud SQL. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#postgresql-cloud-sql
- [parameter] `postgres_database_flags`: Default=see description; Required=no; Description=Database flags set on the Cloud SQL instance. Defaults to `max_connections = 500` plus checkpoint and connection logging flags. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#postgresql-cloud-sql
- [parameter] `postgres_ssl_mode`: Default=`ENCRYPTED_ONLY`; Required=no; Description=Cloud SQL SSL enforcement. `ENCRYPTED_ONLY` requires TLS for every connection. `ALLOW_UNENCRYPTED_AND_ENCRYPTED` accepts plaintext. `TRUSTED_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED` also requires a client certificate. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#postgresql-cloud-sql
- [parameter] `postgres_password`: Default=`""`; Required=when external; Description=Cloud SQL password. Set via `TF_VAR_postgres_password`, or stored in Secret Manager by `setup-env.sh`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#postgresql-cloud-sql
- [parameter] `redis_source`: Default=`external`; Required=no; Description=`external` (Memorystore with private IP) or `in-cluster` (deployed via Helm). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#redis-memorystore
- [parameter] `redis_version`: Default=`REDIS_7_0`; Required=no; Description=Memorystore Redis version. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#redis-memorystore
- [parameter] `redis_memory_size`: Default=`5`; Required=no; Description=Memorystore Redis memory size in GB. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#redis-memorystore
- [parameter] `redis_high_availability`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable Memorystore HA (Standard HA tier). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#redis-memorystore
- [parameter] `redis_prevent_destroy`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Prevent accidental Terraform destroy of the Redis instance. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#redis-memorystore
- [parameter] `clickhouse_source`: Default=`in-cluster`; Required=no; Description=`in-cluster` (dev/POC only), `langsmith-managed` (recommended for production), or `external` (self-hosted). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `clickhouse_host`: Default=`""`; Required=when managed or external; Description=ClickHouse host. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `clickhouse_port`: Default=`9440`; Required=no; Description=ClickHouse native protocol port (`9440` for TLS, `9000` for non-TLS). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `clickhouse_http_port`: Default=`8443`; Required=no; Description=ClickHouse HTTP port (`8443` for TLS, `8123` for non-TLS). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `clickhouse_user`: Default=`default`; Required=no; Description=ClickHouse username. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `clickhouse_password`: Default=`""`; Required=when managed or external; Description=ClickHouse password. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `clickhouse_database`: Default=`default`; Required=no; Description=ClickHouse database name. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `clickhouse_tls`: Default=`true`; Required=no; Description=Enable TLS for ClickHouse connections. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `clickhouse_ca_cert`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=ClickHouse CA certificate (PEM) for TLS verification. Empty uses system CAs. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#clickhouse
- [parameter] `storage_ttl_short_days`: Default=`14`; Required=no; Description=GCS TTL in days for the `ttl_s/` prefix. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gcs-storage

- [parameter] `storage_force_destroy`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Allow bucket deletion even with objects inside. Use with caution. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gcs-storage
- [parameter] `langsmith_namespace`: Default=`langsmith`; Required=no; Description=Kubernetes namespace for LangSmith. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#langsmith-application
- [parameter] `langsmith_domain`: Default=`langsmith.example.com`; Required=no; Description=Fully qualified domain name for LangSmith. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#langsmith-application
- [parameter] `langsmith_license_key`: Default=`""`; Required=no; Description=License key. Use `TF_VAR_langsmith_license_key`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#langsmith-application

- [parameter] `enable_usage_telemetry`: Default=`false`; Required=no; Description=Enable extended usage telemetry reporting (`PHONE_HOME_USAGE_REPORTING_ENABLED`). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [parameter] `langsmith_license_key`: LangSmith enterprise license key. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_admin_password`: Initial org admin password. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_api_key_salt`: Salt for hashing API keys. Must stay stable after first deploy. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_jwt_secret`: JWT secret for Basic Auth sessions. Must stay stable. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_deployments_encryption_key`: Fernet key for LangSmith Deployment. Must never change. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_agent_builder_encryption_key`: Fernet key for Agent Builder. Must never change. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_insights_encryption_key`: Fernet key for Insights. Must never change. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [parameter] `langsmith_polly_encryption_key`: Fernet key for Polly. Must never change. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh
- [definition] GCP Terraform variables reference — Complete reference for every input variable exposed by the [GCP Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/gcp). Use it while filling in `terraform.tfvars` for the first time or tuning an existing deployment. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#gcp-terraform-variables-reference
- [definition] Sizing and feature flags — The `app` Terraform layer and the Helm deploy scripts read these flags to enable the matching chart components and provision per-feature databases. `sizing_profile` is read by the deploy scripts to select the Helm sizing overlay. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sizing-and-feature-flags
- [definition] Sensitive values (set with `setup-env.sh`) — Sourcing `infra/scripts/setup-env.sh` writes these to Google Secret Manager and exports them into the current shell for the Terraform and Helm steps. Never set these inline in `terraform.tfvars`. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables#sensitive-values-set-with-setup-envsh

## Enable TTL and data retention
<https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl>

- [snippet] Helm: config: — `config:` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#requirements
- [snippet] Disabling the job: queue: — `queue:` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#disabling-the-job
- [snippet] Configuring the schedule: queue: — `queue:` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#configuring-the-schedule
- [snippet] Configuring minimum expired rows per part: queue: — `queue:` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#configuring-minimum-expired-rows-per-part
- [snippet] Checking expired rows: -- Query for Runs table. For other tables, replace 'ttl_seconds' with 'trace_ttl_seconds' — `-- Query for Runs table. For other tables, replace 'ttl_seconds' with 'trace_ttl_seconds'` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#checking-expired-rows
- [snippet] Configuring maximum active mutations: queue: — `queue:` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#configuring-maximum-active-mutations
- [snippet] Emergency: Stopping running mutations: SELECT * FROM system.mutations WHERE is_done = 0; — `SELECT * FROM system.mutations WHERE is_done = 0;` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#emergency-stopping-running-mutations
- [snippet] Emergency: Stopping running mutations: KILL MUTATION WHERE mutation_id = '<mutation_id>'; — `KILL MUTATION WHERE mutation_id = '<mutation_id>';` — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#emergency-stopping-running-mutations
- [definition] Enable TTL and data retention — LangSmith Self-Hosted allows enablement of automatic TTL and Data Retention of traces. This can be useful if you're complying with data privacy regulations, or if you want to have more efficient space usage and auto cleanup of your traces. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#enable-ttl-and-data-retention
- [definition] Requirements — You can configure retention through helm or environment variable settings. There are a few options that are configurable: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#requirements
- [definition] ClickHouse TTL cleanup job — As of version **0.11**, a cron job runs on weekends to assist in deleting expired data that may not have been cleaned up by ClickHouse's built-in TTL mechanism. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#clickhouse-ttl-cleanup-job
- [definition] Configuring the schedule — You can customize when the cleanup job runs by modifying the cron expressions: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#configuring-the-schedule
- [definition] Configuring minimum expired rows per part — The job goes table by table, scanning parts and deleting data from parts containing a minimum number of expired rows. This threshold balances efficiency and thoroughness: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#configuring-minimum-expired-rows-per-part
- [definition] Configuring maximum active mutations — Delete operations can be time-consuming (~50 minutes for a 100GB part). You can increase concurrent mutations to speed up the process: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#configuring-maximum-active-mutations
- [definition] Emergency: Stopping running mutations — If you experience latency spikes and need to terminate a running mutation: — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#emergency-stopping-running-mutations
- [definition] Backups and data retention — If disk space does not decrease after running this job, or if it continues to increase, backups may be causing the issue by creating file system hard links. These links prevent ClickHouse from cleaning up the data. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl#backups-and-data-retention

## Self-hosted LangSmith
<https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted>

- [parameter] <a id="langsmith-frontend"></a> **LangSmith frontend**: The frontend uses Nginx to serve the LangSmith UI and route API requests to the other servers. - [parameter] <a id="langsmith-backend"></a> **LangSmith backend**: The backend is the main entrypoint for CRUD API requests and handles the majority of the business logic for the application. - [parameter] <a id="langsmith-queue"></a> **LangSmith queue**: The queue handles incoming traces and feedback to ensure that they are ingested and persisted into the traces and feedback datastore asynchronously, handling checks for data integrity and ensuring successful insert into the datastore, handling retries in situations such as database errors or the temporary inability to connect to the database. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted#services
- [parameter] <a id="langsmith-platform-backend"></a> **LangSmith platform backend**: The platform backend is another critical service that primarily handles authentication, run ingestion, and other high-volume tasks. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted#services
- [parameter] <a id="langsmith-playground"></a> **LangSmith Playground**: The Playground is a service that handles forwarding requests to various LLM APIs to support the Playground feature. - [parameter] <a id="langsmith-ace-arbitrary-code-execution-backend"></a> **LangSmith ACE (Arbitrary Code Execution) backend**: The ACE backend is a service that handles executing arbitrary code in a secure environment. This is used to support running custom code within LangSmith. — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted#services
- [parameter] <a id="clickhouse"></a> **ClickHouse**: [ClickHouse](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/intro) is a high-performance, column-oriented SQL database management system (DBMS) for online analytical processing (OLAP).<br/><br/>LangSmith uses ClickHouse as the primary data store for traces and feedback (high-volume data).<br/><br/>💡 [Connect to external ClickHouse](/langsmith/self-host-external-clickhouse) — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted#storage-services
- [parameter] <a id="postgresql"></a> **PostgreSQL**: [PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/about/) is a powerful, open source object-relational database system that uses and extends the SQL language combined with many features that safely store and scale the most complicated data workloads.<br/><br/>LangSmith uses PostgreSQL as the primary data store for transactional workloads and operational data (almost… — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted#storage-services
- [parameter] <a id="redis"></a> **Redis / Valkey**: [Redis](https://github.com/redis/redis) is a powerful in-memory key-value database that persists on disk. By holding data in memory, Redis offers high performance for operations like caching.<br/><br/>LangSmith uses Redis to back queuing and caching operations. [Valkey](https://valkey.io/) is also officially supported as a drop-in replacement for… — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted#storage-services
- [parameter] <a id="blob-storage"></a> **Blob storage**: LangSmith supports several blob storage providers, including [AWS S3](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/), [Azure Blob Storage](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/services/storage/blobs/), and [Google Cloud Storage](https://cloud.google.com/storage).<br/><br/>LangSmith uses blob storage to store large files, such as trace artifacts, feedback attachments, and… — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted#storage-services
- [definition] Self-hosted LangSmith — Self-hosted LangSmith is an add-on to the Enterprise plan designed for our largest, most security-conscious customers. For more details, refer to [Pricing](https://www.langchain.com/pricing). — https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted#self-hosted-langsmith
